```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(justviz)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

unique(ej_natl$indicator)
# i think looking at traffic and diesel exposure and what populations are in those tracts would be cool
```

``` {r}
#| label: diesel_exposure
diesel_exposure <- ej_natl |>
  filter(indicator == "diesel")

ggplot(diesel_exposure, aes(x = value_ptile)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2,
                   color = "white")

# right-skewed -> md ranks higher against other tracts nationally
```

``` {r}
#| label: traffic
traffic_density <- ej_natl |>
  filter(indicator == "traffic")

ggplot(traffic_density, aes(x = value_ptile)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2,
                 color = "white")

#also right-skewed -> md higher than national
```

``` {r}
#| label: selecting
#| label: selecting
tracts <- acs |>
  filter(level == "tract") |>
  select(county, 
         name, 
         black, 
         no_vehicle_hh, 
         poverty, 
         low_income, 
         pop_density)

car_bad <- ej_natl |>
  filter(indicator %in% c("diesel", "traffic")) |>
  select(tract, 
         indicator, 
         value_ptile)
```

``` {r}
#| label: join
car_bad <- car_bad |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = indicator, values_from = value_ptile)

car_bad <- inner_join(tracts, car_bad, by = c("name" = "tract"))
```

``` {r}
#| label: eda-stuff
ggplot(car_bad, aes(x = diesel, y = black)) +
  geom_point()

```
